# The Aegis Knight-Houses — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **FACING** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Ion Bulwark & Thunderous Joust:** Class 3–5 units have WARD 5+ against ranged attacks from models whose bases are in their front 180° arc (mark the front of the base). Class 3–5 units that charged trigger Crushing Impact for 0 CP and their melee weapons gain [CRASHING] that activation.

**Gamble — Vent the Reactor** *(risk: durability (dice))*: When a Class 3–5 unit activates: its front-arc WARD becomes 4+ and its weapons get +1 Attack until the End of Round. At the End of Round roll a D6: on 1–2 it suffers D3 Fatal Wounds.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Ion Bulwark* — WARD 5+ vs ranged, front arc only (~60% of shots). · *Thunderous Joust* — [CRASHING] on the charge. · *Vent the Reactor* — Occasional +1 Attack.

## Detachment — Noble Lance

*Big knights, few retainers: win the duels and the joust.*

**Detachment rule:** Chivalric Code: before the battle pick 1 Oath (Slay the Warlord · Hold the Line · Lay Low the Tyrant [a Class 4–5 unit]). When it is fulfilled your army becomes Honoured: +1 CP each Command Phase and Class 4–5 units get UNYIELDING 6+.

**Enhancements**
- **Mantle of the Liege** (+20 pts, High Baron in Exalted Knight): The bearer has UNYIELDING 6+ from the start.
- **Heirloom Lance** (+10 pts, Gallant-Class Knight): +1 Damage in melee on a round it charged.

**Stratagems**
- **Rotate Ion-Shields** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit is selected to Shoot a Class 3–5 unit:* Treat the attacker as in the front arc for this attack.
- **Trophy Kill** (1 CP) — *A Class 4–5 unit destroys an enemy Leader:* Fulfil any Oath that targets Leaders; heal D3 MIGHT.
- **Knightly Challenge** (1 CP) — *A Class 4–5 unit is selected to Fight:* Choose one enemy model: all its attacks target that model (precision).

## Detachment — Squire Hunt

*Packs of squire-walkers bonded to a parent knight.*

**Detachment rule:** Bondsman Hunt: Squire-Walkers within 9″ of a Knight they are Bonded to (pick at deployment, up to 2 per Knight) get +1 to Hit against the last enemy unit that Knight attacked.

**Enhancements**
- **Huntmaster's Horn** (+10 pts, Paladin-Class Knight): Bonded Squire-Walkers within 9″ get +1 to Hit with ranged weapons.
- **Fleet-Footed Strider** (+10 pts, Squire-Walker Strider): +2″ MOV.

**Stratagems**
- **Pincer Strike** (1 CP) — *Two Squire-Walkers attack the same target this round:* The second gets +1 PEN.
- **Flushed from Cover** (1 CP) — *A Squire-Walker hits an enemy unit in Cover:* That unit loses Cover until the End of Round.
- **Covering Advance** (1 CP) — *A Squire-Walker activates:* It may make a 3″ move after shooting.

## Detachment — Feudal Muster

*The whole household marches: retainers screen the knights.*

**Detachment rule:** Towering Bulwark: friendly Class 1–2 units within 3″ of a Class 4–5 Knight claim Cover; Knights may move over Class 1–2 enemy models.

**Enhancements**
- **Banner of the House** (+15 pts, Banner-Squire): Friendly Class 1–2 units within 6″ get +1 ARM (to 3+ cap).
- **Veteran Sergeant-at-Arms** (+10 pts, Herald-Seneschal): The attached unit gets +1 to Hit with ranged weapons.

**Stratagems**
- **Hold the Line, Squires!** (1 CP) — *A Class 1–2 unit is charged:* It is not Rattled and its Retaliation Strike gets +1 to Wound.
- **Close the Gap** (1 CP) — *A Class 1–2 unit is destroyed within 6″ of a Knight:* That Knight may make a 3″ move.
- **Muster Call** (2 CP) — *Command Phase, once per battle:* Return a destroyed Feudal Squires unit at half strength within 6″ of your table edge.
